entities.name: Arzakon
entities.description: A powerful demonic planeswalker who tried to take control of Shandalar and was banished.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: The plane Arzakon sought to control.

entities.name: Great Barrier
entities.description: The barrier around Shandalar powered by the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Guardian
entities.description: Defender who lent strength to the Great Barrier.

entities.name: Guild Lords
entities.description: Five lords of Shandalar whom Arzakon convinced to turn on the Guardian.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: Artifact containing Lim-Dul's soul that powers the Great Barrier.

entities.name: Lim-Dul
entities.description: Whose soul is contained in the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Arzakon's War
entities.description: The war Arzakon started on Shandalar.

entities.name: Spell of Dominion
entities.description: A spell the Guild Lords believed would give them control over Shandalar.

events.summary: Arzakon attempts to penetrate the Great Barrier but the Guardian repels him.
events.quote: Ever diligent, the Guardian lent strength to the barrier and easily repelled Arzakon's physical intrusion.

events.summary: Arzakon starts Arzakon's War by convincing the five Guild Lords to turn on the Guardian.
events.quote: Arzakon later started Arzakon's War by convincing the five Guild Lords of Shandalar to turn on the Guardian

events.summary: A spellcaster thwarts the plan and Arzakon is banished from the plane for good.
events.quote: he was banished from the plane for good.

relations.note: He tried to break the Guardian's barrier.
relations.quote: Ever diligent, the Guardian lent strength to the barrier and easily repelled Arzakon's physical intrusion.
